messages:
Maya: Quick copy review needed for the Evals panel empty state. Current copy in figma: "No evals yet. Create one to track model regressions." Link: https://www.figma.com/file/yyy. Thinking we should make the CTA more action-oriented and lower the barrier for new users. Thoughts? Sam: I think "Create one" is a bit dry. For devs we should use "Run a sample eval" as the primary CTA and a secondary "Create eval" for advanced flows. Sample = lower cognitive load. Priya: +1 to sample. Also consider offering a tiny inline example of what an eval does: "Compare model outputs on your prompts." Helps users unsure what "eval" means. Dan: Tone nit: avoid long sentences. Try: primary text: "No evals yet" subtext: "Compare model outputs on your prompts." Primary CTA: "Run sample eval" Secondary link: "Create eval" tertiary link: "Learn about evals" (opens docs). Maya: Nice structure. For mobile we probably collapse to one action + link below. Character budget: primary CTA should be <= 16 chars to fit buttons. "Run sample eval" is 16 incl spaces, nice. Sam: Accessibility note: make sure the CTA has a descriptive aria-label when context is ambiguous, e.g. aria-label="Run sample eval in Evals panel". Also announce when the sample finishes with aria-live polite. Priya: UX nit: the "Learn about evals" link should open in a new tab and have an icon, but for screen readers include "(opens in a new tab)" in the visually-hidden text, not in the visible label. Dan: Analytics: track `evals_empty_shown`, `evals_cta_run_sample_clicked`, `evals_cta_create_clicked` with product_id and user_tier. PM asked for these events to measure effectiveness. Maya: Copy variants for QA: - Option A: primary text: "No evals yet" subtext: "Compare model outputs on your prompts." primary CTA: "Run sample eval" secondary link: "Create eval" tertiary: "Learn about evals" - Option B (more novice friendly): primary text: "Try an example eval" subtext: "See how models perform on sample prompts." primary CTA: "Run example" secondary link: "Create your own" Sam: I prefer A for brevity; B might be better in onboarding flows. Priya: Accessibility snippet suggestion: ```html

No evals yet

Compare model outputs on your prompts.

Create eval Learn about evals (opens in a new tab)
``` Dan: Good snippet. Also make sure focus moves into a small sample-run modal when the user starts the sample so keyboard users get context. Use `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`. Maya: Decision: implement Option A for the product page. Add small helper copy under the CTA for first-time users: "Runs a short example using public prompts. No billing impact." (we should confirm with billing). designbot: lint-check: primary CTA length OK, aria attributes present in snippet, external link pattern correct. Suggest adding `aria-live` for run status. :white_check_mark: Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the figma mocks, add copy tokens, and file a tiny PR to the component README with the accessibility snippet and analytics event names.
